summary: Fed officials signalled patience on further rate cuts as inflation cools slowly. That keeps the rate outlook in focus for US stocks, and no other major market headlines were available. In crypto, Bitcoin rose 1.12% to 121,350.42 dollars over 24 hours.
story1_why: Signals about the pace of rate cuts shape borrowing costs and how investors value stocks across the market.
crypto_note: Bitcoin was at 121,350.42 dollars, up 1.12% over 24 hours, while Ether was at 4,512.10 dollars, down 0.85%.
